conversion_contract.provenance: author release decision for this paper artifact. DIMACS documentation says transit weights are arbitrary, so this is a declared experimental normalization, not an official DIMACS physical-unit claim.
conversion_contract.rounding_policy: exact rational arithmetic internally where possible; deterministic decimal serialization with up to 9 digits after decimal, trimming trailing zeros

score_output.format: gzip-compressed JSON Lines; each object contains an arc_id and piecewise-constant score_intervals as [start_minute, end_minute, score]; scores are zero from 1440 through 10080

temporal_support.extension_policy: preserve first-day rush-window behavior over [0,1440]; extend travel time flat from 1440 to 10080 using the converted static travel time; extend score as zero over [1440,10080]; no periodic repetition; no query-time extrapolation

travel_time_output.format: gzip-compressed JSON Lines; one object per arc; travel_time_breakpoints contains [minute, travel_time] points from 0 through 10080; minutes use declared DIMACS_weight/6000 normalization; values from 1440 through 10080 equal converted base_travel_time
